title: command_result (agent -> hub)
description: Progress and outcome of a command. envelope.correlation_id = command id. Sequence per command: accepted (or rejected) -> zero or more running (with progress) -> exactly one terminal (succeeded | failed | cancelled). Terminal results are retried on reconnect until the hub has consumed them (the hub replies with nothing; the agent forgets a result once it has been sent on a connection that stayed open for 5 s, or when the hub re-sends the same command id and the agent answers with the stored terminal result).

result.description: Command-specific result (shapes documented on each args type in command.json). Present on succeeded; may be partial on failed.

error.description: Required when status is failed or rejected.
